llm.guidance: Install only if you want your agent to access your Gevety account health data. Use a dedicated Gevety API token, keep it out of chat when possible, revoke it when no longer needed, and ask for only the specific labs, medications, documents, or wearable data you need.

vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gevety
Version: 1.12.0

The gevety skill is a comprehensive health data assistant that integrates with the Gevety API to retrieve biomarkers, wearable stats, and medical profiles. All network activity is directed to the official api.gevety.com domain using a user-provided API token. While the skill handles highly sensitive health information, its instructions and logic are strictly aligned with its stated purpose, and it lacks any indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.
